Diwali to Bhai Dooj festival window

conclusions.text: 5 of 19 events separate from zero at the 80% level. Above baseline: Raksha Bandhan (+6.8%), Wedding season (Lagan) muhurat cluster (+5.4%). Below baseline: Chaitra Navratri (−6.5%), Karwa Chauth (−6.8%), Ayodhya Deepotsav (−6.8%).
Wedding season (Lagan) muhurat cluster is the only grade-A effect: +5.4% (80% interval +3.0% to +8.0%, 12 occurrences, 139 quoted days).
Pooled festival windows sit at +0.8% (95% interval −4.9% to +6.8%), too imprecise to confirm or reject the direction the calendar expects.
The path runs from ₹89.0 on 2026-10-29 to ₹99.8 on 2027-12-31, with the seasonal shape peaking at ₹105.6 around 2027-02-11 and bottoming at ₹84.4 around 2027-08-14.

The 95% interval at the end of the horizon is ₹59.2 to ₹168.2 — a band about 109% as wide as the central value. That width is the honest summary of what this history supports; the level is one draw from it, the shape is the part worth trusting.
The selected model (anchor_events) scores 14.2% sMAPE overall, 12.0% at 8–28 days and 15.7% at 29–90 days. ma7_events scores 12.8% overall, so no single model dominates.
13 of 19 events have at most two quoted days inside their window, and 151 of 576 calendar days have no quote at all. Event conclusions are therefore associations in a thin sample, not causal effects.
